Questions 11 and 12

Choose TWO letters, A-E.

According to Megan, what are the TWO main advantages of working in the agriculture and horticulture sectors?

Questions 13 and 14

Choose TWO letters, A-E.

Which TWO of the following are likely to be disadvantages for people working outdoors?

Questions 15–20

What information does Megan give about each of the following job opportunities?

Choose SIX answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-H, next to Questions 15-20.

15 Fresh food commercial manager

16 Agronomist

17 Fresh produce buyer

18 Garden centre sales manager

19 Tree technician

20 Farm worker

Information
A not a permanent job
B involves leading a team
C experience not essential
D intensive work but also fun
E chance to earn more through overtime
F chance for rapid promotion
G accommodation available
H local travel involved

transcript.en: Hello everyone. My name's Megan Baker and I'm a recruitment consultant at AVT Recruitment specialists.
transcript.zh: 大家好，我的名字是Megan Baker，我是AVT招聘专家公司的招聘顾问。

transcript.en: Now, our company specialises in positions that involve working in the agriculture and horticulture sectors, so that's fresh food production,garden and park maintenance and so on.
transcript.zh: 现在我们的招聘主要涉及的职位，包括农业和园艺，比如说生鲜食品的生产，花园和公园的维护维修等等。

transcript.en: And these sectors do provide some very special career opportunities.
transcript.zh: 这些行业确实会给你提供一些特别的就业机会。

transcript.en: For a start, they often offer opportunities for those who don't want to be stuck with a 40-hour week,
transcript.zh: 首先它可以为那些不想束缚在一周工作40个小时，

transcript.en: but need to juggle work with other responsibilities such as child care-and this is very important for many of our recruits.
transcript.zh: 需要兼顾工作和其他诸如照顾小孩等职责的人提供一些工作机会。这对很多应聘者来说非常重要。

transcript.en: Some people like working in a rural setting, surrounded by plants and trees instead of buildings,although we can't guarantee that.
transcript.zh: 有些人喜欢在偏远地区工作，周围环绕着的是植物树木而不是建筑，但是我们不能确保一定是这样。

transcript.en: But there are certainly health benefits,especially in jobs where you're not sitting all day looking at a screen - a big plus for many people.
transcript.zh: 然而这确实对身体是有一定好处的，尤其是当我们不需要一整天都坐着并且对着电脑来工作。这对于很多人来说都是一个大福利。

transcript.en: Salaries can sometimes be good too,although there's a lot of variety here.
transcript.zh: 有的工作岗位工资可能比较高，但不同工作的报酬也各不相同。

transcript.en: And you may have the opportunity in some types of jobs for travel overseas,although that obviously depends on the job, and not everyone is keen to do it.
transcript.zh: 有些工作可能有机会出国，但是这肯定是取决于工作本身，并不是所有的人都喜欢这样的。

transcript.en: Of course, working outdoors does have its challenges.
transcript.zh: 当然在室外工作会有一定的挑战，

transcript.en: It's fine in summer, but can be extremely unpleasant when it's cold and windy.
transcript.zh: 夏天是没有问题的。当很冷或者是风很大的时候，就可能会特别不舒服。

transcript.en: You may need to be pretty fit for some jobs,though with modern technology that's not as important as it once was.
transcript.zh: 有的工作可能要求员工比较健壮，但是由于现代科技技术，这项要求已经没有之前那么重要了。

transcript.en: And standards of health and safety are much higher now than they used to be,so there are fewer work-related accidents.
transcript.zh: 健康和安全的标准变得比以前高很多，所以跟工作相关的事故是越来越少发生的。

transcript.en: But if you like a lively city environment surrounded by lots of people, these jobs are probably not for you - they're often in pretty remote areas.
transcript.zh: 如果你喜欢充满生机的，周围都是人的城市环境，这里的工作可能不适合你，这些工作经常是在偏远地区的。

transcript.en: And some people worry about finding a suitable place to live, but in our experience, this usually turns out fine.
transcript.zh: 有人可能会担心找不到合适的住处，但以我们的经验来看，这个一般都能解决。

transcript.en: Now let me tell you about some of the exciting jobs that we have on our books right now.
transcript.zh: 接下来让我来为大家介绍一下我们现在招聘的好职位。

transcript.en: One is for a fresh food commercial manager.
transcript.zh: 第一个工作是生鲜食品商业经理，

transcript.en: Our client here is a very large fresh food producer supplying a range of top supermarkets.
transcript.zh: 我们的委托人是一家大型生鲜食品生产商，

transcript.en: They operate in a very fast-paced environment with low profit margins - the staff there work hard,
transcript.zh: 他们为各种各样顶尖的超市供货。这家公司运作的节奏非常快，但是利润很低。员工工作的非常努力。

transcript.en: but they play hard as well, so if you've a sociable personality this may be for you.
transcript.zh: 当然他们休闲娱乐生活也很丰富，所以如果你擅长社交，这项工作会适合你。

transcript.en: We have an exciting post as an agronomist advising farmers on issues such as crop nutrition,protection against pests,
transcript.zh: 我们还有另外一个非常好的职位是农学家，为农民提供一些建议，比如说农作物的营养，保护农作物避免害虫的破坏，

transcript.en: and the latest legislation on farming and agricultural practices.
transcript.zh: 以及关于农业实践方面最新的一些法律条款。

transcript.en: There are good opportunities for the right person to quickly make their way up the career ladder,but a deep knowledge of the agricultural sector is expected of applicants.
transcript.zh: 这对有的人来说是非常快速的职业晋升途径，但是申请这项工作的人需要有丰富的农业方面的知识。

transcript.en: A leading supermarket is looking for a fresh produce buyer who is available for a 12-month maternity cover contract.
transcript.zh: 一家大型超市正在招聘生鲜采购员，合同为期 12 个月，用于顶替产假员工。

transcript.en: You need to have experience in administration, planning and buying in the fresh produce industry, and in return will receive a very competitive salary.
transcript.zh: 应聘者需要在管理，策划和生鲜食品采购方面有经验，当然作为回报薪水也非常可观。

transcript.en: We have also received a request for a sales manager for a chain of garden centres.
transcript.zh: 我们还收到了来自一家花卉连锁店需要销售经理的委托。

transcript.en: You will be visiting centres in the region to ensure their high levels of customer service are maintained.
transcript.zh: 你需要在这个地区的各个花卉中心巡视以确保能为顾客提供高质量服务，

transcript.en: This post is only suitable for someone who is prepared to live in the region.
transcript.zh: 这份工作适合可以住在这个地区的人。

transcript.en: There is also a vacancy for a tree technician to carry out tree cutting, forestry and conservation work.
transcript.zh: 我们还有一个园林技师职位空缺，负责树木修剪以及森林维护保护工作。

transcript.en: Candidates must have a clean driving licence and have training in safety procedures.
transcript.zh: 应聘者必须有一个良好的驾驶记录，还要做过安全程序培训。

transcript.en: A year's experience would be preferred but the company might be prepared to consider someone who has just completed an appropriate training course.
transcript.zh: 最好是有一年的工作经验，但是公司可能也接受刚刚完成正规培训课程的员工。

transcript.en: Finally, we have a position for a farm worker.
transcript.zh: 最后，我们还有一个职位是农场工人。

transcript.en: This will involve a wide range of farm duties including crop sowing and harvesting, machine maintenance and animal care.
transcript.zh: 这份工作涉及到很多农场的工作，包括庄家的播种，丰收，机器维修以及照顾牲畜。

transcript.en: Perks of the job include the possibility of renting a small cottage on the estate, and the chance to earn a competitive salary.
transcript.zh: 这份工作的福利是公司可能会在住宅区为你租房，还有机会获得丰厚的收入。

transcript.en: A driving licence and tractor driving experience are essential.
transcript.zh: 驾照和拖拉机驾驶证是必须要有的。
